linkedIssue.body: Let users filter the receipts list by account, including receipts with no account. Keyboard users keep focus on the filter after they pick.

existingComments.author: olivercederborg
existingComments.body:
`AGENT` Claude Opus 5.5 · on behalf of **Oliver**
Picking an account moves keyboard focus to another option: the list re-renders with the pick first, but `onPick` focuses the pick's old position. Focusing the picked option by its value would fix it.

replies.author: robin-dev
replies.body: Fixed: options have stable ids now and focus follows the picked value. Added tests.
